description: Sprint 10/11/14 E2E test ACLs. Differentiated per-folder groups so security trimming returns different results per group. Each folder may also grant direct per-user access via an optional 'users' array (Entra user object IDs) OR'd with 'groups' at query time. testset/finance/private is granted ONLY to a user (no group) to exercise the allowed_users path; testset/hr/onboarding grants BOTH groups AND a direct user (mirroring the SharePoint UserIds+GroupIds pattern) to exercise the combined case. Paths are the src_key (object path relative to the S3 bucket root, e.g. 'testset/finance/reports') and are mode-independent: the same keys apply whether files are read via the OneLake shortcut (source_mode=s3_shortcut) or directly from S3 (source_mode=s3_direct). Resolution is nearest-ancestor: a subfolder entry overrides its parent. engineering/* is intentionally omitted to exercise the no_acl skip path. Group/user GUIDs are placeholders for Entra object IDs the calling app injects per user. See PRODUCT_SPEC.md section 10 and the Sprint 10/14 E2E section.
